description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Sublime Epiphany and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Sublime Epiphany copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
